text:
- [LFAC.2.5.4] **Equality basis: `String` / `Bytes` by
  content, not pointer.** The no-op vs meaningful-change
  decision on `String` and `Bytes` slots — and the
  identity-key match ([LFAC.1.7]) — is by **byte content**,
  never by interned-pointer identity. Interning is a
  non-observable runtime optimization ([IRET.1.4] /
  [IDAT.4.7]): a conforming implementation MUST NOT depend
  on two equal strings sharing a pointer, nor expose
  interned-pointer identity across the wire or any
  observable surface. Two facts with byte-equal
  `String`/`Bytes` slots are equal regardless of how the
  runtime stores those bytes (interned engine-lifetime,
  refcounted, arena-copied, or duplicated), so the
  intern-leak seal's refcount + arena machinery is invisible
  to conforming programs.

idris.name: lfac_2_5_4__same_fact
idris.note: Field-wise equality of facts: id, kind and values by content, never by identity of representation.

idris.name: lfac_2_5_4__same_fact_refl
idris.note: A fact is the same as itself: identity and slots compared by content.
